findings.Finding: The session table declares no time-to-live, so it may grow without bound.
findings.WhyItMatters: Without a TimeToLiveSpecification, expired session items are never removed; the table grows indefinitely, raising cost and eventually operational risk.

Evidence.Detail: SessionTable has no TimeToLiveSpecification, and a session store is a table whose items are expected to expire.

findings.Recommendation: Declare a TimeToLiveSpecification on an expiry attribute so expired sessions are removed automatically.
findings.SuggestedRemediation: Enable a time-to-live attribute on the table (TimeToLiveSpecification with an ExpiresAt attribute) so expired sessions are purged.
